title: Inspect a changed inventory
task: Save the first three rows of services.csv to preview.csv. Save only the second comma-separated field from every row as owners.txt. Preserve services.csv.
hints: Read services.csv. Separate the task that selects rows from the task that selects a field within every row.

cut -d ',' -f 2 services.csv > owners.txt
Then run cli-silly check.

checks.label: The preview contains exactly the first three complete rows
checks.feedback: Use head -n 3 or an equivalent row selection. Preserve the full rows and their order.

checks.label: The owner report keeps one field per input row in order
checks.feedback: Choose comma as the delimiter and field 2. Preserve repeated owners and the input order.

demo.explanation: This sample has three rows and two fields per row. These simple records contain no quoted commas.
head is the command, -n is the option, 2 is its value, and tasks.csv is the input operand. Only the row count changes.
cut selects the second field from every row. It neither sorts nor removes duplicates; the repeated owner remains.
